data.name: Hudhafah
data.gender_notes: Hudhafah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hudhafah ibn Al-Yaman was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). He was known for his deep knowledge of the Quran and his strong commitment to Islam. Hudhafah was a trusted advisor and a close friend to the Prophet, who often consulted him on religious matters. The name Hudhafah carries the meaning “Friend of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hudhafah usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
